name: Nicaragua
description: Nicaragua from its first peoples to Spanish rule, William Walker, Sandino, the Somozas, the Sandinista revolution, the Contras and Ortega.

checkpoints.name: Spanish rule
checkpoints.note: Spain founded León and Granada in 1524.

checkpoints.name: Republic and invasion
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1821. William Walker made himself president in 1856, and American marines occupied the country and fought Sandino.

checkpoints.name: Somozas and Sandinistas
checkpoints.note: The Somozas ruled until 1979. The Sandinistas then fought the Contras.

checkpoints.name: Since 1990
checkpoints.note: Chamorro won in 1990. Ortega returned in 2007 and has ruled ever more harshly.
